description: Golden-set retrieval eval against a specific vector_index_snapshot partition. Asset check fails on regression vs the prior materialization.

outputs.description: One row per golden query: query, expected_terms, top_k_docs, matched_terms, score

snapshot_root_dir.label: Snapshot Root Dir
snapshot_root_dir.description: Same snapshot_root_dir the upstream vector_index_snapshot writes to. The partition_key (snapshot_id) locates the specific snapshot directory.

collection_name.label: Collection Name
collection_name.description: ChromaDB collection name (must match the upstream snapshot's collection_name).

golden_set.label: Golden Set
golden_set.description: List of {query: str, expected_terms: [str]} dicts. Each query is issued against the snapshot; the score is the fraction of `expected_terms` that appear (case-insensitive substring match) in any of the top-k retrieved chunks. Mean across queries is the asset's precision@k.

min_score_threshold.label: Min Score Threshold
min_score_threshold.description: Absolute minimum precision@k score. Asset check fails below this.

regression_pct_threshold.label: Regression Pct Threshold
regression_pct_threshold.description: Max allowed drop (in percentage points) vs the immediately-prior materialization. Asset check fails if this snapshot's score is prior_score - threshold or lower.

dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name
dynamic_partition_name.description: Name of the DynamicPartitionsDefinition registered by vector_index_snapshot.

upstream_snapshot_asset_key.label: Upstream Snapshot Asset Key
upstream_snapshot_asset_key.description: Optional: the vector_index_snapshot asset key to declare as an upstream dep in the graph. Not required for execution (we load from disk).

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Freshness policy: max lag between evals (per snapshot).

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy.

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage (output col → list of upstream cols).

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a `preview` metadata key (markdown table of first rows).

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows in the preview when include_preview_metadata=True.
